info.title: Jobseeker Copilot - Application Tracker API
info.description:
Service for tracking job applications, their generated documents, and application status.

This service validates and stores exact approved Document Store version
references. Current editable selections are separate from the immutable
versions and explicit omissions frozen only when an application
first enters APPLIED.
Atomic document-selection commands require explicit SELECTED or OMITTED
state for both optional slots, an expected record version and a durable
owner-scoped idempotency key.
Applying requires expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key, re-verifies
every selected exact version, and commits both frozen slot states,
timestamps and content-free events atomically.
Durable reconciliation verifies both reference sets against Document Store,
repairs only missing immutable metadata, and reports conflicts without
overwriting historical evidence.
Ordered Store lifecycle projections mark exact references archived,
deleted or purged. Purge keeps family/version identity and association
history while scrubbing complete hashes and evidence details.
It does NOT store document contents.

ApplicationStatus values:
- SAVED - Job has been saved to the claimant's applications
- DOCUMENTS_GENERATED - Documents have been generated for the job
- APPLIED - Application has been submitted
- INTERVIEW - Interview stage
- UNSUCCESSFUL - Application was unsuccessful
- OFFER - Offer received
- ACCEPTED - Offer accepted
- REJECTED_BY_USER - Offer or opportunity rejected by the user
- WITHDRAWN - User withdrew their application

put.summary: Atomically save the complete optional document selection
put.description:
Replaces the desired CV and cover-letter slots together while the
application is SAVED or DOCUMENTS_GENERATED. Both slot objects are
mandatory and must explicitly say SELECTED or OMITTED, preventing a
partial rolling-deploy payload from being interpreted as a clear.
Exact approved and available versions are verified against Document
Store. Family current is recommendation metadata only.

put.summary: Project exact document availability into application history
put.description: Applies an ordered owner-scoped lifecycle projection. PURGED is terminal and scrubs complete hashes and evidence details while retaining exact family/version identity.

post.summary: Create or replay an application record
post.description:
Creates an authoritative generated, manual or external application.
Repeating the same owner-scoped Idempotency-Key and payload returns
the existing record.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Owner-scoped retry key. Legacy producers without a key receive deterministic request-based idempotency.

200.description: Existing application replayed for the same idempotency key

400.description: Validation error or ineligible document reference

409.description: Idempotency key reuse or duplicate canonical application

post.description: Starts or resumes durable generated-document cleanup; the application is removed only after cleanup completes

post.summary: Start or resume a durable document replacement
post.description: Reserves one Tracker-owned operation before any replacement document or file is written

400.description: Application is locked or request differs from active operation

patch.description: Bearer users follow the public lifecycle matrix. APPLIED requires expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key and atomically freezes exact selections and omissions. Approved producers are restricted to SAVED-to-DOCUMENTS_GENERATED and idempotent recovery of that completed bridge.

documentId.description: Exact approved Document Store version. Required only when state is SELECTED.

DocumentSelectionCommand.description: Explicit desired state for one optional application document slot. Omission of this object is never interpreted as clearing the slot.

expectedVersion.description: Application record version observed by the client.

SaveDocumentSelectionsRequest.description: Complete desired CV and cover-letter selection. Both slot objects are required so older or partial clients cannot accidentally clear a selection.

id.description: Unique identifier of the application record

userId.description: ID of the user who owns this application

jobId.description: ID of the job being applied to

provenance.description: How the application entered the tracker

cvDocumentId.description: ID of the generated CV document (reference only)

coverLetterDocumentId.description: ID of the generated cover letter document (reference only)

applicationUsedCvState.description: Whether the frozen CV slot is selected, explicitly omitted or unknown legacy state

applicationUsedCoverLetterState.description: Whether the frozen cover-letter slot is selected, explicitly omitted or unknown legacy state

applicationUsedAt.description: Timestamp when application-used references were frozen

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

appliedAt.description: Timestamp when the application was submitted (null if not yet applied)

version.description: Monotonic record version for optimistic concurrency

DocumentEvidenceProvenance.description:
Immutable profile, evidence-snapshot and claim provenance
retained with an exact document version.

DocumentVersionReference.description: Canonical immutable Document Store version descriptor

EvidenceRevisionReference.description: Exact immutable evidence revision selected for a document

ValidatedClaimLedger.description:
Non-sensitive identity and digest of the exact claim ledger
accepted by generation validation.

ApplicationVersionConflictResponse.description: Stale application command response with the authoritative current record

SystemDataApplicationSeedRecord.description: Constrained application fixture record; ownership and scenario come from the request envelope

SystemDataApplicationSeedRequest.description: Versioned, owner- and scenario-scoped Application Tracker fixture request

userId.description: ID of the user creating the application

jobId.description: ID of the job being applied to

companyName.description: Name of the company offering the job

cvDocumentId.description: Approved CV version ID in Document Store; optional for manual/external applications

coverLetterDocumentId.description: Approved cover-letter version ID in Document Store; optional for manual/external applications

provenance.description: How the application entered the tracker. Defaults to GENERATED for backwards-compatible producers.

initialStatus.description: Initial lifecycle state. GENERATED may start as DOCUMENTS_GENERATED or APPLIED; MANUAL and EXTERNAL default to APPLIED and may explicitly start as SAVED.

CreateApplicationRequest.description: Request to create a new application record

applicationId.description: Application record ID that was withdrawn

status.description: Status the job should show after withdrawal

withdrawn.description: Whether the generated application was withdrawn

retryable.description: Whether the incomplete workflow can be retried automatically

recoveryCode.description: Stable non-sensitive recovery reason when work is incomplete

completedAt.description: UTC completion time when document cleanup and withdrawal committed

WithdrawGeneratedApplicationResponse.description: Response returned when generated documents are withdrawn before applying

BeginDocumentReplacementRequest.description: Starts or resumes a durable application document replacement

expectedVersion.description: Optional record version last observed by the caller; stale values return HTTP 409

occurredAt.description: UTC time when the lifecycle milestone actually occurred; defaults to receipt time

reason.description: Optional concise reason or outcome evidence for the transition

UpdateStatusRequest.description: Request to update the status of an application

SecurityErrorResponse.description: Stable redacted authentication or authorization error

RegisterReplacementDocumentRequest.description: Registers the exact Store document created for a durable replacement

ApplicationHistoryResponse.description: Owner-scoped ordered page of immutable application events

DocumentApplicationAssociationsResponse.description: Content-free authoritative application associations for one exact document version
